flow_ref: User story (not in any OCMS flow deck)
code_summary: ocmsadminapi workflows/cas_integration/{CasIntegrationController,service/CasIntegrationServiceImpl} (casUpdateCourtNotices from CAS), notice_management/stage/changestage/ChangeStageServiceImpl (PLUS change stage), api-authorization.properties. ocmsadminui pages/Notice/{hook/useStagePermissions,form/History,detail/Overview}. No recorder of mention outcome (DNATA) and no automatic stage revert.
note: The story asks that, when the registered address changed, OCMS automatically records the court notice mention outcome (e.g. DNATA) and reverts the processing stage so the notice returns to the pool eligible for court application. Nothing matches. DNATA appears only as a UI message text (useStagePermissions.tsx:86: 'apply DNATA and perform an EMCONs'), with no code that applies it. /v1/courtmention is only listed in api-authorization.properties:23 with no controller/entity; Icourtmention.d.ts has mention_outcome but only as a UI type, and the UI only shows mention_date (Overview.tsx:338, History.tsx:95-98). The CAS endpoint casUpdateCourtNotices (CasIntegrationController.java:101) can write last/prev/next processing stage, but the values are sent by CAS (CasIntegrationServiceImpl.java:437-439) and there is no mention outcome field (CasUpdateNoticeItem.java:32-38); it is not credited because OCMS does not detect the address change or record the outcome. ChangeStageServiceImpl.java:29 is a change stage from PLUS. The court application pool lives in CAS, not in the six repos. Status blank; traced normally.
recommendation: Do not claim. Recording of mention outcome/DNATA and the automatic stage revert do not exist in the six repos; they are probably in CAS. Ask URA to confirm.

steps.step: OCMS detects a registered address change on the returned court summons
steps.detail: No logic concludes 'address changed' (see OCMS28.2 and OCMS28.4: no address comparison) and there is no link to a court summons. Searched: address change, changed address, DNATA, courtmention in both layers.

steps.step: OCMS automatically records the court notice mention outcome (e.g. DNATA)
steps.detail: No recorder of mention outcome exists. DNATA is only a UI message text (useStagePermissions.tsx:86). /v1/courtmention exists only in api-authorization.properties:23 with no controller/entity/repository; mention_outcome is only a type in Icourtmention.d.ts. The UI only reads mention_date (Overview.tsx:338; History.tsx:95-98).

steps.step: OCMS automatically reverts the notice processing stage
steps.detail: OCMS does not revert automatically. casUpdateCourtNotices (CasIntegrationController.java:101; CasIntegrationServiceImpl.java:437-439) only writes the stage that CAS sends; change stage from PLUS is in ChangeStageServiceImpl.java:29. Both are inbound endpoints from other systems and are not credited. Whether CAS sends this revert: cannot verify from repo.

steps.step: The notice returns to the pool eligible for court application
steps.detail: No court application pool or eligibility flag exists in the six repos. plus-get-court-case-info (CasIntegrationController.java:167) only reads information for PLUS. The pool lives in CAS: cannot verify from repo.
